old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.156","title":"[spec-gap][R-02AT-007] 02a-tdma.md beacon wire format stale vs decision rule-0x08 and implemented 24B header","description":"Spec 02a-tdma.md:23-30 defines beacon content as: Type 1B 0xBE; SFN u32; Timestamp u32; Stratum u8 (0=GNSS,1=mesh); N_slots u8 default 8-32; slot bitmap or assigned list; Next beacon delta u16 ms; and line 23 says SCHC-compressed on CH0. Classification: divergent. All three stacks implement the 24-byte fixed uncompressed header (epoch u32, num_slots u8, sfn u32, timestamp u32, flags u8, rx_chains u8, setup_window u16, occupied_time u16, guard u8, channel_mask u32) + CBOR slot_map + trailing 48B Schnorr48 sig: rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs:84-131, python/src/lichen/rpl/tdma_beacon.py:46-123, lichen/subsys/lichen/link/beacon.c:26-98 (layout doc beacon.h:12-24). No 0xBE type byte exists in any code (only hit is the spec line itself); stratum rides the DIO Time option 0x15, not the beacon; no next_beacon_delta wire field (beacon_delta_ms is only a drift function: python/src/lichen/timing/ccp7.py:14, rust/lichen-link/src/tdma_clock.rs:12); no slot bitmap (CBOR slot_map list only). The SCHC-on-CH0 claim contradicts adjudicated decision rule-0x08-tdma-beacon in spec/decisions.jsonl (beacon is fixed-format uncompressed). R-02AT-008: N_slots default 8 is implemented (lichen_tdma_compute_slot tdma.c:53, ccp.py:434) but the 8-32 upper bound is enforced nowhere (only nonzero checks, rust tdma_beacon.rs:123-125). Suggested placement: amend spec/02a-tdma.md lines 23-30 to reference the coordinated-capacity 2a.2 uncompressed layout (coordinate with existing bead project-LICHEN-worker6-0aod which aligns 02a-coordinated-capacity.md), drop or explicitly re-add next-beacon-delta and beacon-stratum as new wire fields, and either pin the 8-32 range in all parsers or make the spec say nonzero-u8.
